service.method: SELECT HOUSE_CODE , COMPANY_CODE , COMPANY_NAME FROM USERVICE WHERE COMPANY_CODE = '1000' AND HOUSE_CODE = $S{HOUSE_CODE} AND #DB_OWNER#NVL(DEL_FLAG, 'N') = 'N' AND ( UPPER( HOUSE_CODE ) LIKE '%' || UPPER( $S{F_KEYWORD} ) || '%' OR UPPER( COMPANY_CODE ) LIKE '%' || UPPER( $S{F_KEYWORD} ) || '%' OR UPPER( COMPANY_NAME ) LIKE '%' || UPPER( $S{F_KEYWORD} ) || '%')

SELECT MUPD.MENU_PROFILE_CODE , MUPD.COMPANY_CODE , CMGL.COMPANY_NAME_LOC , LANG.CONTENTS MENU_PROFILE_NAME FROM (SELECT MENU_PROFILE_CODE ,COMPANY_CODE ,HOUSE_CODE FROM SMUPD WHERE HOUSE_CODE = '000' AND MENU_PROFILE_CODE <> 'COMMON' GROUP BY HOUSE_CODE, MENU_PROFILE_CODE, COMPANY_CODE) MUPD JOIN SCMGL CMGL ON MUPD.HOUSE_CODE = CMGL.HOUSE_CODE AND MUPD.COMPANY_CODE = CMGL.COMPANY_CODE JOIN SLANG LANG ON MUPD.HOUSE_CODE = LANG.HOUSE_CODE AND MUPD.MENU_PROFILE_CODE = LANG.CODE AND LANG.SCREEN_ID ='MENU_PROFILE' AND LANG.LANGUAGE = 'KO' AND ( 1=1 ) ORDER BY CASE WHEN MENU_PROFILE_CODE = 'ADD' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END , MENU_PROFILE_CODE

SELECT MUPD.MENU_PROFILE_CODE , MUPD.MENU_ID , MUPD.PARENT_MENU_ID , #DB_OWNER#nvl(PDLANG.CONTENTS, PDLANG_DEFAULT.CONTENTS) MENU_NAME , MUPD.SCREEN_ID , MUPD.ITEM_SEQ , MUID.URL , MUID.MOBILE_URL , MUID.AUTH_URL , #DB_OWNER#nvl(MUPD.MENU_IMG, MUID.MENU_IMG) MENU_IMG , MUID.SUMMARY_FLAG , MUPD.ETC_FLAG , MUPD.HIDDEN_FLAG , MUID.ATTACH_NO , MUPD.HOUSE_CODE , MUPD.MODULE
, CASE WHEN (SELECT MENU_ID FROM SMUFP MUFP WHERE MUPD.MENU_PROFILE_CODE = MUFP.MENU_PROFILE_CODE AND MUPD.MENU_ID = MUFP.MENU_ID AND MUFP.HOUSE_CODE = ${HOUSE_CODE} ) IS NOT NULL THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS MENU_FILTERED_YN
FROM SMUPD MUPD LEFT OUTER JOIN SLANG PDLANG ON MUPD.HOUSE_CODE = PDLANG.HOUSE_CODE AND MUPD.MENU_ID = PDLANG.CODE AND PDLANG.SCREEN_ID = 'MENU_' || MUPD.MENU_PROFILE_CODE AND PDLANG.LANGUAGE = ${session.LANGUAGE} LEFT OUTER JOIN SLANG PDLANG_DEFAULT ON PDLANG_DEFAULT.HOUSE_CODE = '000' AND MUPD.MENU_ID = PDLANG_DEFAULT.CODE AND PDLANG_DEFAULT.SCREEN_ID = 'MENU_' || MUPD.MENU_PROFILE_CODE AND PDLANG_DEFAULT.LANGUAGE = ${session.LANGUAGE} LEFT OUTER JOIN SMUID MUID ON MUPD.HOUSE_CODE = MUID.HOUSE_CODE AND MUPD.SCREEN_ID = MUID.SCREEN_ID WHERE #DB_OWNER#NVL(MUPD.DEL_FLAG,'N') = 'N' AND MUPD.HOUSE_CODE= '000' AND MUPD.MENU_PROFILE_CODE = ${CODE} ORDER BY PARENT_MENU_ID , TO_NUMBER(#DB_OWNER#NVL(ITEM_SEQ,'0'))
